rationale.conceptual: The method is an established but non-trivial procedure from elasticity theory, involving the construction of the dynamic matrix for a hexagonal crystal, solving cubic characteristic equations, and computing strain derivatives of the polynomial coefficients. The task requires careful translation of the physics into code, but not a novel research algorithm.
rationale.execution: The workflow has two sequential steps (compute elastic constants, then compute and output the table). The steps are straightforward I/O and use only standard numerical libraries; no complex orchestration, tooling, or data acquisition is required.
